verdict.rationale: Grafana documents an official CLI (probe-5). The observability-as-code docs describe terminal-based authentication, multi-environment management and administrative tasks suited to CI/CD and local development (docs-26), so the core of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: evidence that the CLI is designed for or used in AI/agent-driven workflows, depth on commands and output formats, independent or hands-on corroboration.
